```yaml
name: Claude Code

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      issue_number:
        description: 'Issue number to fix'
        required: true
        type: number
      instructions:
        description: 'Additional instructions for Claude'
        required: false
        type: string

permissions:
  contents: write
  pull-requests: write
  issues: read

jobs:
  claude-code:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    concurrency:
      group: claude-${{ github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: false

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Check collaborator status
        id: check-collab
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          ACTOR: ${{ github.actor }}
        run: |
          IS_COLLAB=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token $GH_TOKEN" \
            -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/$REPO/collaborators/$ACTOR" | jq -r '.message // empty')
          
          if [ "$IS_COLLAB" = "Not Found" ]; then
            echo "::error::User $ACTOR is not a collaborator"
            exit 1
          fi
          echo "User is a collaborator"

      - name: Get issue details
        id: issue
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          ISSUE_NUM: ${{ inputs.issue_number }}
        run: |
          ISSUE_DATA=$(curl -s -H "Authorization: token $GH_TOKEN" \
            -H "Accept: application/vnd.github+json" \
            "https://api.github.com/repos/$REPO/issues/$ISSUE_NUM")
          
          echo "title=$(echo $ISSUE_DATA | jq -r '.title')" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "body=$(echo $ISSUE_DATA | jq -r '.body')" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT
          echo "labels=$(echo $ISSUE_DATA | jq -r '.labels[].name' | paste -sd, -)" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Setup Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm ci

      - name: Run Claude Code
        id: claude
        env:
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ inputs.issue_number }}
          ISSUE_TITLE: ${{ steps.issue.outputs.title }}
          ISSUE_BODY: ${{ steps.issue.outputs.body }}
          ISSUE_LABELS: ${{ steps.issue.outputs.labels }}
          INSTRUCTIONS: ${{ inputs.instructions }}
        run: |
          # Create a temporary file with the issue context
          cat > /tmp/issue_context.md << EOF
          # Issue #${ISSUE_NUMBER}
          
          ## Title
          ${ISSUE_TITLE}
          
          ## Description
          ${ISSUE_BODY}
          
          ## Labels
          ${ISSUE_LABELS}
          
          ## Additional Instructions
          ${INSTRUCTIONS}
          EOF

          # Run Claude Code with the context
          npx @anthropic-ai/claude-code \
            --prompt "Fix the issue described in /tmp/issue_context.md. Make minimal changes to fix the problem. Ensure all tests pass." \
            --output-format json \
            --max-turns 10 \
            --timeout 600

      - name: Create Draft PR
        if: success()
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          ISSUE_NUMBER: ${{ inputs.issue_number }}
        run: |
          # Check if there are changes
          if git diff --quiet HEAD; then
            echo "No changes detected"
            exit 0
          fi

          # Create a new branch
          BRANCH_NAME="claude/fix-issue-${ISSUE_NUMBER}"
          git checkout -b $BRANCH_NAME
          
          # Add and commit changes
          git add .
          git commit -m "fix: resolve issue #${ISSUE_NUMBER} via Claude Code"
          git push origin $BRANCH_NAME
          
          # Create draft PR
          gh pr create \
            --title "fix: resolve issue #${ISSUE_NUMBER}" \
            --body "This PR was automatically generated by Claude Code to fix issue #${ISSUE_NUMBER}.

          ## Changes
          - Automated fix based on issue description
          - Generated by Claude Code workflow

          ## Related Issue
          Closes #${ISSUE_NUMBER}" \
            --label "automated" \
            --label "claude-code" \
            --draft \
            --head $BRANCH_NAME \
            --base main
```
